title: PINCH & OPEN
hint: That key is far too big for the lock. Can you change its size?
desc: Rimpicciolisci la chiave col pizzico e apri la porta.
hints: That key is far too big for the lock. Can you change its size?
Use two fingers on the key.
Pinch the key smaller, then drag it into the lock.

title: TILT MAZE
hint: No buttons here: the phone itself moves the ball. Reach the glowing star.
desc: Inclina il telefono e porta la sfera alla stella (inclinazione).
hints: No buttons here: the phone itself moves the ball. Reach the glowing star.
Hold the phone like a tray and lean it.
Tilt the phone gently: the ball rolls downhill. Lead it to the star.

title: BIG RED BUTTON
hint: A hungry cat never sleeps. Is there anything to eat around here?
desc: Dai il pesce al gatto, poi lascialo dormire senza toccare nulla: il pulsante è un'esca.
hints: A hungry cat never sleeps. Is there anything to eat around here?
The painting isn't just a painting.
Drag the fish from the painting to the cat, then don't touch anything for 5 seconds.

title: SLICE IT!
hint: No knife? No problem. A quick finger is sharp enough.
desc: Taglia la mela con un colpo di dito.
hints: No knife? No problem. A quick finger is sharp enough.
Swipe, don't tap.
Swipe fast across the whole apple, from one side to the other.

title: BEEP BEEP
hint: Listen carefully. Short and long... Tap the radio to hear it again.
desc: Ascolta il codice Morse della radio e premi il tasto giusto (audio).
hints: Listen carefully. Short and long... Tap the radio to hear it again.
Short beep = dot, long beep = dash.
Write down the short/long pattern and press the button with the same Morse code.

title: TICK TOCK
hint: Follow the wires. Only one of them really goes to the timer.
desc: Disinnesca la bomba prima che scada il tempo.
hints: Follow the wires. Only one of them really goes to the timer.
Trace each wire with your eyes from the timer.
Cut only the wire that actually reaches the timer box.

title: SHHH!
hint: That music is way too loud for a cat. Maybe your phone can do something about it.
desc: Fai dormire il vicino abbassando il volume del telefono a zero (tasti volume).
hints: That music is way too loud for a cat. Maybe your phone can do something about it.
Your phone has volume buttons.
Press the phone's volume DOWN button until the music is off.

title: HOLD ON
hint: One finger is not enough. Keep both pressed until the timer runs out.
desc: Tieni premuti insieme i due pulsanti fino a fine conto.
hints: One finger is not enough. Keep both pressed until the timer runs out.
Use two fingers at the same time.
Keep one finger on each button until the countdown ends. Don't lift them!

title: BUG SPRAY
hint: Hold your finger down to spray up. The can won't last forever!
desc: Uno scarafaggio cammina sul muro: spruzzalo con lo spray tossico prima che la bomboletta si svuoti.
hints: Hold your finger down to spray up. The can won't last forever!
Spray where the roach is going, not where it is.
Keep your finger pressed to spray and follow the roach until it stops moving.

title: ART THEFT
hint: Locked again? Some paintings are more realistic than they look.
desc: La chiave è nascosta nel quadro: trovala e apri la porta.
hints: Locked again? Some paintings are more realistic than they look.
Look closely at the painting.
The key in the painting is real: drag it out and into the door.

title: SNOWMAN
hint: Give the snowman a happy face. Eyes and nose go on the head... and the smile? Draw it in the snow!
desc: Completa il pupazzo di neve (occhi, naso, sorriso) senza farlo sciogliere.
hints: Give the snowman a happy face. Eyes and nose go on the head... and the smile? Draw it in the snow!
Coal for the eyes, carrot for the nose.
Put the coal eyes and carrot nose on the head, then draw a smile on its face with your finger.
eggHow: Invece che sul naso, lascia la carota sul sedere del pupazzo: arrossisce dalla vergogna e si scioglie.

title: BODYGUARD
hint: Draw walls with your finger. The wasp hates walls.
desc: Disegna barriere per proteggere il gatto dalla vespa per 10 secondi.
hints: Draw walls with your finger. The wasp hates walls.
Walls between the wasp and the cat.
Draw short walls around the cat, on the wasp's side, and keep it out for 10 seconds.

title: LIGHTS ON
hint: Red ink under red light is hard to read... what if both lights were on?
desc: Accendi le due lampade per leggere la scritta.
hints: Red ink under red light is hard to read... what if both lights were on?
Each lamp hides something.
Switch on BOTH lamps: the hidden words appear.

title: COOKIE JAR
hint: That cookie won't come out by itself. Maybe turn the world upside down?
desc: Inclina il barattolo e fai rotolare il biscotto fino al topolino; se cade troppo forte si rompe (inclinazione).
hints: That cookie won't come out by itself. Maybe turn the world upside down?
Tip the jar by tilting the phone.
Turn the phone upside down slowly so the cookie rolls out gently to the mouse.

title: MAKE A WISH
hint: Candles don't like wind. Your phone has a microphone...
desc: Spegni le candeline soffiando; troppo forte e volano via. (microfono)
hints: Candles don't like wind. Your phone has a microphone...
Blow on the microphone.
Blow steadily at the bottom of the phone to put out every candle.
eggHow: Soffia FORTISSIMO nel microfono: le candeline (fiamme comprese) volano via dalla torta.

title: TRAP MAZE
hint: A round maze: go around the rings to the star in the middle. Mind the holes... and the lasers keep a rhythm.
desc: Labirinto con buche e laser a tempo (inclinazione).
hints: A round maze: go around the rings to the star in the middle. Mind the holes... and the lasers keep a rhythm.
The gaps in the rings alternate top and bottom.
Tilt around the rings through the gaps, wait for the lasers to switch off, avoid the holes.

title: IN THE DARK
hint: Who turned off the lights? Every locked gate has a key somewhere.
desc: Labirinto al buio: prendi la chiave, poi raggiungi il cancello (inclinazione).
hints: Who turned off the lights? Every locked gate has a key somewhere.
The light follows the ball.
Find the key first (it opens the gate), then roll through the gate to the star.

title: HIDDEN SAFE
hint: That painting is stuck to the wall. Maybe a good shake would help?
desc: Scuoti il telefono per far cadere il quadro, leggi il codice e apri la cassaforte (scuotimento).
hints: That painting is stuck to the wall. Maybe a good shake would help?
Shake the phone.
Shake the phone to drop the painting, read the code on its back, type it on the safe.

title: BEDTIME
hint: A sleepy cat needs darkness, silence... and nobody poking it.
desc: Spegni la luce, azzera il volume e lascia dormire il gatto (volume).
hints: A sleepy cat needs darkness, silence... and nobody poking it.
Light, sound... and hands off.
Switch off the lamp, turn the phone volume to zero, then don't touch for a few seconds.

title: LIFT OFF
hint: Rockets need fuel. And launch buttons are always protected.
desc: Fai il pieno al razzo, alza la protezione e lancia.
hints: Rockets need fuel. And launch buttons are always protected.
Fuel first.
Drag the fuel can to the rocket, flip up the cover, then press the launch button.

title: LOW BATTERY
hint: Robots run on electricity. So does your phone...
desc: Ricarica il robot: caricatore vero o dinamo a manovella. (caricatore)
hints: Robots run on electricity. So does your phone...
The robot wants a charger... or a workout.
Plug your phone into a real charger, or spin the crank until the battery is full.
eggHow: Collega il telefono a un caricatore vero: il robot si ricarica e si trasforma in un mecha da battaglia.

title: HOT SOUP
hint: Careful, it's boiling! How do you cool soup down?
desc: Raffredda la zuppa soffiando, poi dalla al topolino. (microfono)
hints: Careful, it's boiling! How do you cool soup down?
Blow on it like real soup.
Blow into the microphone until the thermometer is low, then give the soup to the mouse.
eggHow: Dai la zuppa al topolino quando è ancora bollente (senza soffiare): diventa rosso, fuma e prende fuoco.

title: FROZEN KEY
hint: Ice melts with a little friction. And that key looks huge...
desc: Strofina il ghiaccio, rimpicciolisci la chiave e apri la porta.
hints: Ice melts with a little friction. And that key looks huge...
Rub the ice quickly.
Rub the ice block with your finger until it melts, pinch the key smaller, open the door.

title: CAMPFIRE
hint: Rub the stick to make a spark, then blow... gently!
desc: Strofina il bastoncino per la scintilla, poi soffia piano (microfono).
hints: Rub the stick to make a spark, then blow... gently!
Rub, then blow... softly.
Rub the stick fast for a spark, then blow GENTLY into the microphone.

title: STUCK!
hint: Toni tried the cat flap. Bad idea. Pushing alone won't do... something slippery from the kitchen, maybe?
desc: Toni è incastrato nella gattaiola: lascia cadere il burro su di lui, poi toccalo (o spingilo verso il muro).
hints: Toni tried the cat flap. Bad idea. Pushing alone won't do... something slippery from the kitchen, maybe?
Try the things on the table on Toni.
Drag the butter onto Toni, then tap him (or push him toward the wall).
eggHow: Spingi Toni 8 volte SENZA il burro: la pressione trova un'altra uscita (PRRRT!) e parte a razzo.

title: WAKE-UP CALL
hint: Little ink: short fences get hopped over. Corner the OFF button before the neighbor wakes up!
desc: Il pulsante OFF della sveglia scappa: chiudilo con staccionate (inchiostro limitato, salta quelle corte) prima che si svegli il vicino.
hints: Little ink: short fences get hopped over. Corner the OFF button before the neighbor wakes up!
Fences must be long enough.
Draw long fences to trap the OFF button in a corner, then tap it.

title: THIRSTY PLANT
hint: Pull the drop back, aim, mind the wind... and let go!
desc: Fionda: 5 gocce su 10 nel vaso, con il vento. Colpisci l'uccello di passaggio.
hints: Pull the drop back, aim, mind the wind... and let go!
Watch the windsock before you shoot.
Pull back and release when the wind is calm; land 5 drops in the pot.
eggHow: Colpisci con una goccia della fionda l'uccellino che ogni tanto attraversa il cielo.

title: SHELL GAME
hint: Keep your eyes on the box with the mouse.
desc: Segui la scatola col topolino; la codina sbuca solo a mescolamento finito.
hints: Keep your eyes on the box with the mouse.
Never look away from that box.
Follow the box with the mouse until it stops, then tap it.

title: SKY WIRE
hint: Read the note. Then look out of the window.
desc: Taglia il filo indicato dall'indovinello sul biglietto (colore a caso).
hints: Read the note. Then look out of the window.
The answer is a colour.
The sky is the colour in the riddle: cut the wire of that colour.

title: SUNNY DAY
hint: Snowmen hate the sun. Could a cloud help?
desc: Copri il sole con la nuvola finché tramonta.
hints: Snowmen hate the sun. Could a cloud help?
Keep the sun covered.
Drag the cloud over the sun and keep it there until the sun sets.
eggHow: Lascia il sole scoperto troppo a lungo: il pupazzo urla e si scioglie del tutto.

title: CUT THE ROPE
hint: Cut one rope, wait for the swing, then cut the other.
desc: Taglia le corde al momento giusto per far arrivare il biscotto.
hints: Cut one rope, wait for the swing, then cut the other.
Timing is everything.
Cut one rope, wait until the candy swings toward the mouse, cut the other.

title: PIZZA PARTY
hint: Four friends, four slices. Cut right through the middle!
desc: Taglia la pizza in quattro e dai una fetta a ogni topolino.
hints: Four friends, four slices. Cut right through the middle!
Two cuts are enough.
Swipe once across and once down through the centre, then drag a slice to each mouse.

title: PIZZA CHEF
hint: Grandma's recipe is on the chalkboard: exactly those, nothing more!
desc: Segui la ricetta (casuale) disegnata sulla lavagna, inforna, taglia e servi.
hints: Grandma's recipe is on the chalkboard: exactly those, nothing more!
Read the board carefully.
Put on exactly the toppings drawn on the board, bake it, cut it and serve it.
eggHow: Metti il peperoncino sulla pizza: i topi strillano, diventano paonazzi con gli occhi in fiamme.

title: BLOW IT UP
hint: Fill the dotted line. Not a puff more!
desc: Gonfia il palloncino fino alla sagoma e aspetta 2 secondi (microfono o pompa).
hints: Fill the dotted line. Not a puff more!
Stop at the line.
Pump (or blow) until the balloon fills the dotted outline, then wait 2 seconds.

title: CAT EYES
hint: The cat's eyes follow your phone. Stare at the mouse!
desc: Muovi gli occhi del gatto inclinando il telefono e fissa il topolino 3 secondi (inclinazione).
hints: The cat's eyes follow your phone. Stare at the mouse!
The eyes follow the tilt.
Tilt the phone so the cat's eyes look at the mouse and hold it for 3 seconds.

title: PANCAKE FLIP
hint: A quick flick of the wrist... not too gentle, not too wild.
desc: Tre giri della frittella con un colpo di polso (scuotimento + inclinazione).
hints: A quick flick of the wrist... not too gentle, not too wild.
One short flick upward.
Give the phone a quick, medium upward flick, three times.

title: STING RUN
hint: Tilt to the star. The wasp follows the corridors: loop around the walls!
desc: Labirinto aperto con più strade: arriva alla stella seminando la vespa (inclinazione).
hints: Tilt to the star. The wasp follows the corridors: loop around the walls!
The wasp can't cut through walls.
Lead the wasp around a wall block, then dash for the star on the other side.

title: SECRET CODE
hint: Red light hides red ink. Blue light hides blue ink. Remember!
desc: Luci rossa e blu mai insieme: leggi metà codice per volta e apri la cassaforte.
hints: Red light hides red ink. Blue light hides blue ink. Remember!
One lamp at a time.
Turn on red to read the blue digits, then blue to read the red ones. Type the full code.

title: APPLE CATCH
hint: Shake the tree, tilt the basket. Five apples for a pie.
desc: Scuoti l'albero e prendi 5 mele col cesto (scuotimento + inclinazione).
hints: Shake the tree, tilt the basket. Five apples for a pie.
Shake, then tilt.
Shake the phone to drop apples, tilt to move the basket under them. Catch 5.

title: MARBLE RUN
hint: Draw up to three ramps. Hold GO longer for a stronger push!
desc: Disegna fino a 3 rampe; tieni premuto GO per la forza della spinta.
hints: Draw up to three ramps. Hold GO longer for a stronger push!
Ramps guide the marble.
Draw a ramp from the marble down to the cup, then hold GO for a medium push.

title: COPYCAT
hint: Watch the cat, listen, then play it back.
desc: Ripeti le sequenze di luci e note del gatto (3, 4, 5 note).
hints: Watch the cat, listen, then play it back.
Watch AND listen.
Repeat the cat's lights in the same order after each sequence.

title: ZIG ZAG
hint: The star is in the middle, but the pink gates open and close. Time it!
desc: Labirinto a griglia con tre cancelli che si aprono e chiudono da soli: aspetta il momento giusto.
hints: The star is in the middle, but the pink gates open and close. Time it!
Gates open in turns.
Wait next to each pink gate until it opens, then roll through.

title: PANCAKE TOWER
hint: Four flips this time. Steady wrist!
desc: Come il 35, ma 4 giri.
hints: Four flips this time. Steady wrist!
Same flick, four times.
Four quick, medium upward flicks.

title: SHELL SHOCK
hint: Faster hands, more swaps. Watch the tail!
desc: Shell Game con 14 scambi più veloci.
hints: Faster hands, more swaps. Watch the tail!
Same trick, faster.
Follow the box with the mouse until it stops, then tap it.

title: CODE BREAKER
hint: Five digits now. Red light, blue light... memory!
desc: Come il 37, codice a 5 cifre.
hints: Five digits now. Red light, blue light... memory!
One lamp at a time.
Red lamp shows the blue digits, blue lamp shows the red ones. Type all five.

title: TOP SHELF
hint: The jar moved higher. Tilt it out, roll it over.
desc: Cookie Jar specchiato con il barattolo più in alto.
hints: The jar moved higher. Tilt it out, roll it over.
Tip it the other way.
Tilt slowly so the cookie rolls out and down to the mouse without breaking.

title: BODYGUARD 2
hint: Angrier wasp, only two walls. Draw them well.
desc: Vespa più veloce, solo 2 barriere, 12 secondi.
hints: Angrier wasp, only two walls. Draw them well.
Make every wall count.
Draw two long walls between the wasp and the cat.

title: BIG BALLOON
hint: Bigger balloon, longer wait. Patience...
desc: 14 pompate, 3 secondi di attesa.
hints: Bigger balloon, longer wait. Patience...
Patience at the end.
Fill the outline exactly, then wait 3 seconds without pumping.

title: TRAP MAZE 2
hint: Hug the walls around the holes. Wait for the laser.
desc: Labirinto nuovo con buche (più piccole) e un laser.
hints: Hug the walls around the holes. Wait for the laser.
Lasers switch off for a moment.
Hug the walls, wait for the laser to turn off, then roll to the star.

title: TUG OF WAR
hint: The house key is missing and Toni looks VERY innocent. Pull the sock out... gently! Yank it and he pulls back.
desc: Tira PIANO il calzino: escono gli oggetti, la chiave per ultima. 5 strattoni = egg.
hints: The house key is missing and Toni looks VERY innocent. Pull the sock out... gently! Yank it and he pulls back.
Slow and steady.
Grab the sock and pull it slowly away from Toni. Repeat until the key comes out.
eggHow: Dai 5 strattoni al calzino: Toni vince il tiro alla fune e si rimangia tutto il mucchio (*BURP*).

title: BIG BIRTHDAY
hint: Seven candles. Take a deep breath!
desc: 7 candeline; troppo forte e volano via.
hints: Seven candles. Take a deep breath!
Long, steady breath.
Blow steadily into the microphone until all seven candles are out.

title: HIGH PLANT
hint: The pot is up on the shelf. Aim higher!
desc: Il vaso è su una mensola in alto.
hints: The pot is up on the shelf. Aim higher!
Higher arc.
Pull back further and aim up; wait for calm wind.

title: COPYCAT PRO
hint: Longer songs, quicker paws.
desc: Sequenze da 4, 5 e 6 note, più veloci.
hints: Longer songs, quicker paws.
Say the notes out loud.
Repeat each sequence in the same order.

title: WASP RETURNS
hint: Fifteen hits. Two stings and you're out: swat it while it lunges to stop the sting!
desc: La vespa con la paletta: 15 colpi. Due punture = perso (colpiscila mentre si lancia per pararla).
hints: Fifteen hits. Two stings and you're out: swat it while it lunges to stop the sting!
Hit it when it charges.
Swat the wasp the moment it dives at you; 15 hits.

title: MARBLE RUN 2
hint: Right to left now, over a taller wall.
desc: Da destra a sinistra, muretto più alto.
hints: Right to left now, over a taller wall.
Go over, not through.
Draw a ramp that climbs over the wall, then a strong GO.

title: LASER POINTER
hint: Only a red dot wakes this cat. Tap the mirrors to turn them and bounce the laser to it.
desc: Tocca gli specchi per girarli e porta il raggio laser al gatto che dorme. Batteria limitata.
hints: Only a red dot wakes this cat. Tap the mirrors to turn them and bounce the laser to it.
Mirrors turn when tapped.
Turn each mirror so the beam bounces from the pen to the sleeping cat.

title: TINY MOUSE
hint: A tiny mouse that changes hole every 3 seconds. Follow it with the cat's eyes!
desc: Il topolino cambia tana ogni 3 secondi: seguilo con lo sguardo del gatto (inclinazione).
hints: A tiny mouse that changes hole every 3 seconds. Follow it with the cat's eyes!
Follow the mouse.
Tilt so the eyes always point at the mouse's current hole.

title: SNOOZE ALARM
hint: A faster button, only three fences.
desc: Wake-up Call con pulsante più veloce e 3 staccionate.
hints: A faster button, only three fences.
Few fences: make them long.
Trap the OFF button in a corner with 3 long fences, then tap it.

title: DARKER
hint: Find the key in the dark. The gate is somewhere up there.
desc: Labirinto al buio nuovo.
hints: Find the key in the dark. The gate is somewhere up there.
Key first.
Find the key, then go up to the gate and the star.

title: APPLE RAIN
hint: Six apples this time, and they fall a bit faster.
desc: 7 mele, cadono più veloci.
hints: Six apples this time, and they fall a bit faster.
Stay under the tree.
Shake to drop apples, tilt the basket under each one. Catch them all.

title: WET WOOD
hint: It's raining! Hold the umbrella over the fire (not too close!) and get it going before the mouse freezes.
desc: Piove: tieni l'ombrello sopra il fuoco (non troppo vicino) mentre lo accendi, o il topolino congela.
hints: It's raining! Hold the umbrella over the fire (not too close!) and get it going before the mouse freezes.
The umbrella goes above, not on.
Hold the umbrella over the fire, a bit higher, while you rub and blow.
eggHow: Tieni l'ombrello troppo vicino al fuoco: prende fuoco e si accartoccia.

title: FLASHLIGHT
hint: Your finger is a torch. Find the light switch... and don't shine on whatever sleeps up there.
desc: Buio: il dito è una torcia. Trova l'interruttore e toccalo; non illuminare a lungo i pipistrelli che dormono.
hints: Your finger is a torch. Find the light switch... and don't shine on whatever sleeps up there.
The switch is on a wall.
Sweep the torch along the walls, find the switch and tap it; avoid the bats.

title: DOUBLE STING
hint: Two wasps, many roads. Loop around them!
desc: Labirinto aperto con due vespe che ti inseguono (inclinazione).
hints: Two wasps, many roads. Loop around them!
Make them follow you around a block.
Loop the wasps around a wall block and then run for the star.

title: BRIDGE BUILDER
hint: Draw a bridge with the little ink you have, then press GO. Not too steep!
desc: Disegna un ponte (inchiostro limitato) perché il topolino attraversi il burrone.
hints: Draw a bridge with the little ink you have, then press GO. Not too steep!
Gentle slopes.
Draw a flat bridge from edge to edge, then press GO.

title: SHORT FUSE
hint: Same bomb, half the time. Think fast!
desc: Come il 6, con 6 secondi.
hints: Same bomb, half the time. Think fast!
Same wires, less time.
Cut the only wire that reaches the timer.

title: COPYCAT MAESTRO
hint: Five, six, seven notes. Hum along!
desc: Sequenze da 5, 6 e 7 note.
hints: Five, six, seven notes. Hum along!
Chunk the notes.
Repeat each sequence in the same order.

title: TRAP MAZE 3
hint: Two lasers this time. Patience pays.
desc: Buche e due laser, controllo addolcito (inclinazione).
hints: Two lasers this time. Patience pays.
Wait for both lasers.
Move only when the laser in front of you switches off.

title: MAGIC RUNE
hint: Copy the rune from the scroll in ONE stroke inside the circle. Three runes open the chest.
desc: Ricopia col dito le rune del mago (13 rune possibili, ne escono 3 a caso), 3 tentativi.
hints: Copy the rune from the scroll in ONE stroke inside the circle. Three runes open the chest.
One single stroke.
Trace each rune in one go, without lifting your finger, inside the circle.

title: FOGGY MIRROR
hint: Someone wrote the code on the mirror with a finger. How do you make it show up?
desc: Soffia sul telefono per appannare lo specchio e leggere il codice, poi aprilo sull'armadietto.
hints: Someone wrote the code on the mirror with a finger. How do you make it show up?
Fog shows finger marks.
Blow into the microphone to fog the mirror, read the code, type it on the cabinet.
eggHow: Soffia sullo specchio senza fermarti per più di 5 secondi: sulla condensa compare "BRUSH YOUR TEETH!".

title: FIVE BEEPS
hint: Five beeps this time, long and short. Tap the radio to listen again.
desc: Morse con segnali da 5 suoni lunghi o corti.
hints: Five beeps this time, long and short. Tap the radio to listen again.
Dots and dashes again.
Write down the 5 short/long beeps and press the matching code.

title: PITCH BLACK
hint: Something buzzes in the dark. Listen: louder means closer. Take another road!
desc: Al buio, con una vespa che si sveglia se la illumini; il ronzio cresce avvicinandosi.
hints: Something buzzes in the dark. Listen: louder means closer. Take another road!
The buzzing tells where the wasp is.
When the buzz gets loud, take another path; don't light the wasp.

title: SHELL STORM
hint: Twenty swaps, lightning fast.
desc: 20 scambi velocissimi.
hints: Twenty swaps, lightning fast.
Don't blink.
Follow the box with the mouse until it stops, then tap it.

title: DJ MOUSE
hint: Tap when a note is in the ring, on the beat. Never tap the grey notes!
desc: Tocca quando la nota è nel cerchio, a tempo di musica. Mai le note grigie con la X.
hints: Tap when a note is in the ring, on the beat. Never tap the grey notes!
Tap on the beat.
Tap only when a coloured note is inside the ring; skip grey notes.

title: BODYGUARD 3
hint: Two wasps, fifteen seconds. Walls not touching the cat can be shoved!
desc: Due vespe; spingono via le barriere non attaccate al gatto.
hints: Two wasps, fifteen seconds. Walls not touching the cat can be shoved!
Attach walls to the cat.
Draw walls that touch the cat: those can't be pushed away.

title: WHERE'S TONI?
hint: Toni is hiding... and snoring. Move your finger around the room and listen (and feel): the closer, the louder.
desc: Muovi il dito: russare più forte vicino al nascondiglio; tocca il posto giusto.
hints: Toni is hiding... and snoring. Move your finger around the room and listen (and feel): the closer, the louder.
Keep your finger on the screen and move it around.
Where the snoring is loudest and the phone vibrates, tap that hiding spot.

title: WASP HALL
hint: Two angry wasps on both sides. Find the gap!
desc: Labirinto aperto con due vespe più aggressive.
hints: Two angry wasps on both sides. Find the gap!
Use the side passages.
Lure the wasps to one side, then cut through the other.

title: TWO DOORS
hint: Two keys are hidden in this room. Listen to the knocking... the monster knocks harder.
desc: Due chiavi nascoste (pavimento e quadro), due porte: dietro una la ragazza, dietro l'altra il mostro che bussa più forte.
hints: Two keys are hidden in this room. Listen to the knocking... the monster knocks harder.
One key on the floor, one in the painting.
Find both keys and open the door with the SOFTER knocking.

title: MASTER CODE
hint: Six digits. Maybe write them down?
desc: Come il 37, codice a 6 cifre.
hints: Six digits. Maybe write them down?
Write it down.
Red lamp shows blue digits, blue lamp shows red ones. Type all six.

title: THIRSTY TREE
hint: Up on the shelf, six drops, and the wind comes in gusts. Wait for the calm!
desc: Vaso sulla mensola, 6 gocce, raffiche di vento da 1-4 secondi.
hints: Up on the shelf, six drops, and the wind comes in gusts. Wait for the calm!
Gusts come and go.
Wait for the windsock to hang down, then shoot; 6 drops.

title: PLUMBER
hint: Tap the pipes to turn them. Get the water from the tap to the flower!
desc: Tocca i tubi per ruotarli e porta l'acqua dal rubinetto al fiore prima che appassisca.
hints: Tap the pipes to turn them. Get the water from the tap to the flower!
Start from the tap.
Rotate pipes one by one following the path from the tap to the flower.

title: FAKE COIN
hint: One coin is heavier. Put coins on the pans (tap to move them), two weighings, then pick the fake.
desc: 9 monete, una pesa di più: mettile sui piatti, solo due pesate, poi tocca la falsa.
hints: One coin is heavier. Put coins on the pans (tap to move them), two weighings, then pick the fake.
Split in three groups.
Weigh 3 vs 3: if balanced the fake is in the other 3; then weigh 1 vs 1.

title: SPOT IT
hint: Five differences between the two pictures. Tap them! Three wrong taps and you lose.
desc: Trova le 5 differenze tra i due disegni (cambiano ogni volta). 3 tocchi sbagliati = perso.
hints: Five differences between the two pictures. Tap them! Three wrong taps and you lose.
Compare small details.
Check colours, missing pieces and shapes; tap the 5 differences.

title: WHERE'S MOUSE?
hint: Find the mouse with the RED hat. Pinch to zoom, drag to look around.
desc: Nella folla trova il topolino col cappellino ROSSO: due dita per ingrandire, un dito per spostarti.
hints: Find the mouse with the RED hat. Pinch to zoom, drag to look around.
Zoom in.
Pinch to zoom and scan row by row for the red hat.

title: TIGHTROPE
hint: He leans, you lean the OTHER way. Watch out for the wind!
desc: Il funambolo pende: inclina il telefono dalla parte opposta per tenerlo dritto (più stabile, raffiche leggere).
hints: He leans, you lean the OTHER way. Watch out for the wind!
Counter-balance.
Tilt opposite to the lean, small movements, until he reaches the end.

title: SHADOW PLAY
hint: Match the shadow on the wall. One finger moves, two fingers turn and resize.
desc: Fai combaciare l'oggetto con l'ombra sul muro: un dito sposta, due dita ruotano e ingrandiscono. 3 oggetti.
hints: Match the shadow on the wall. One finger moves, two fingers turn and resize.
Rotate with two fingers.
Drag the object onto the shadow, then rotate and resize it until it matches.

title: WASP KING
hint: The biggest, fastest wasp yet. Twenty hits!
desc: La vespa con la paletta: 20 colpi, più veloce.
hints: The biggest, fastest wasp yet. Twenty hits!
Same trick, faster.
Swat it the moment it dives; 20 hits.

title: STARING CONTEST
hint: Tiny, faster mouse. Seven seconds of staring in total!
desc: Topolino piccolo che cambia tana ogni 2,5 secondi: 7 secondi di sguardo in tutto.
hints: Tiny, faster mouse. Seven seconds of staring in total!
Stay on the mouse.
Keep the eyes on the mouse for a total of 7 seconds.

title: HOUSE OF CARDS
hint: Tap to place each card. Hold the phone very still... and wait for the wind to calm down.
desc: Tocca per posare le carte; tieni il telefono fermo e aspetta che la tenda smetta di sventolare. 9 carte.
hints: Tap to place each card. Hold the phone very still... and wait for the wind to calm down.
Stillness.
Hold the phone still and place a card only when the curtain isn't moving.

title: PAPER PLANE
hint: Tilt to pitch the nose: dive to gain speed, climb to spend it. Blow for a push. Every ring!
desc: Inclina per alzare/abbassare il muso (in picchiata accelera), soffia per una spinta: passa in tutti gli anelli (diventano verdi).
hints: Tilt to pitch the nose: dive to gain speed, climb to spend it. Blow for a push. Every ring!
Dive for speed.
Tilt down to speed up, up to climb, blow for a push; go through every ring.

title: SAFE CRACKER
hint: Turn the dial right, left, right. Listen for the CLUNK and stop there.
desc: Gira la manopola destra-sinistra-destra; al numero giusto fa CLUNK: fermati lì. 60 secondi.
hints: Turn the dial right, left, right. Listen for the CLUNK and stop there.
Listen.
Turn right until CLUNK, then left until CLUNK, then right until CLUNK.

title: MERRY-GO-ROUND
hint: The ride only turns if YOU turn. Spin around with the phone: three turns, then stop.
desc: Gira su te stesso col telefono: 3 giri di giostra, poi fermati.
hints: The ride only turns if YOU turn. Spin around with the phone: three turns, then stop.
You have to spin.
Stand up and turn around with the phone: three full turns, then stop.
eggHow: Continua a girare su te stesso oltre i giri richiesti: il gatto finisce con gli occhi a spirale.

title: SLIDE PUZZLE
hint: Tap a tile next to the hole to slide it. Fix the portrait before the cat wakes up!
desc: Ricomponi il ritratto del gatto facendo scorrere i tasselli prima che si svegli.
hints: Tap a tile next to the hole to slide it. Fix the portrait before the cat wakes up!
Corners first.
Slide tiles into the hole to rebuild the cat's portrait, row by row.

title: DOMINO
hint: Fill the gaps so the dominoes ring the bell. A falling tile reaches as far as it is tall.
desc: Metti le tessere giuste nei due buchi e tocca la prima: il campanello deve suonare.
hints: Fill the gaps so the dominoes ring the bell. A falling tile reaches as far as it is tall.
Height matters.
Put tiles tall enough to reach the next ones, then tap the first tile.

title: MIRROR PATH
hint: Guide the mouse along the path. Your finger moves him... the wrong way round.
desc: Porta il topolino lungo il sentiero (più largo): i comandi sono invertiti, poi anche su e giù.
hints: Guide the mouse along the path. Your finger moves him... the wrong way round.
Everything is reversed.
Move your finger the opposite way of where the mouse should go.

title: MAGNET FISHING
hint: Fish the key out with the magnet. Caught junk? Shake it off. Watch the piranha!
desc: Pesca la chiave con la calamita; scuoti per staccare i rottami; il piranha morde il filo.
hints: Fish the key out with the magnet. Caught junk? Shake it off. Watch the piranha!
Shake off the junk.
Lower the magnet on the key, shake the phone to drop junk, avoid the piranha.

title: CUCKOO CLOCK
hint: Solve the riddle, set the hands, press the button. The cuckoo hates wrong answers.
desc: Risolvi l'indovinello, sposta le lancette e premi il pulsante.
hints: Solve the riddle, set the hands, press the button. The cuckoo hates wrong answers.
Read the riddle twice.
Set the hands to the time in the riddle and press the button.
eggHow: Imposta le lancette a mezzogiorno in punto e premi il pulsante.

title: FIREFLIES
hint: Catch six fireflies while they glow. Yellow lights in pairs that don't move are NOT fireflies.
desc: Tocca 6 lucciole mentre brillano, solo del colore scritto sul barattolo (cambia ogni 2). Coppie di luci ferme = lupo.
hints: Catch six fireflies while they glow. Yellow lights in pairs that don't move are NOT fireflies.
Check the jar.
Tap only glowing fireflies of the colour written on the jar; ignore still pairs.

title: CHEATING CAT
hint: Find the pairs. Every three mistakes the cat swaps two cards. Watch the paw!
desc: Memory a coppie; ogni 3 errori il gatto scambia due carte coperte. Max 10 errori.
hints: Find the pairs. Every three mistakes the cat swaps two cards. Watch the paw!
Remember positions.
Match pairs carefully; after 3 mistakes watch which cards the paw swaps.

title: BUBBLE COUNT
hint: Pop the bubbles from 1 to 8. Careful: some numbers are upside down.
desc: Scoppia le bolle da 1 a 8 (numeri scritti in modi diversi, alcuni capovolti). Il 9 non serve.
hints: Pop the bubbles from 1 to 8. Careful: some numbers are upside down.
Read upside down too.
Pop 1 to 8 in order; some are written as words, dots or upside down.

title: TONI'S BIRTHDAY
hint: Toni has to blow out his candle... but pugs can't blow. That peacock feather looks ticklish... and his nose is RIGHT there.
desc: Solletica il naso di Toni con la piuma di pavone finché starnutisce.
hints: Toni has to blow out his candle... but pugs can't blow. That peacock feather looks ticklish... and his nose is RIGHT there.
Tickle his nose.
Drag the peacock feather to Toni's nose and wiggle it until he sneezes.

title: SNEAKY MOUSE
hint: Drag the mouse to the cheese without being lit by the torch. Furniture casts shadows. Don't run!
desc: Trascina il topolino al formaggio fuori dalla torcia del cane, dietro i mobili, senza correre.
hints: Drag the mouse to the cheese without being lit by the torch. Furniture casts shadows. Don't run!
Shadows are safe.
Move slowly from one piece of furniture to the next, staying in the shadows.

title: BLIND STOPWATCH
hint: Start, then stop at exactly the time shown. The digits vanish after two seconds!
desc: Ferma il cronometro al tempo richiesto: dopo 2 secondi le cifre spariscono. 3 tentativi.
hints: Start, then stop at exactly the time shown. The digits vanish after two seconds!
Count in your head.
Start it, count the seconds in your head, stop it at the target (±0.25 s).
eggHow: Ferma il cronometro subito dopo averlo avviato, in meno di un quarto di secondo.

title: WHACK-A-MOLE
hint: Bonk the angry moles (gold = 3). Never the party moles!
desc: 12 punti in 25 s: colpisci le talpe arrabbiate nelle buche del prato (oro = 3), mai quelle col cappellino.
hints: Bonk the angry moles (gold = 3). Never the party moles!
Watch the hats.
Hit angry moles (gold counts 3) and never moles with a party hat.
eggHow: Colpisci il gatto che ogni tanto spunta da una buca al posto delle talpe.
